# The state every block item places (none: nothing) in fifteen contexts, as both official servers decide it (harness
# 0.15.0 placement report: the item's own placement and survival check, a grass block below the target). Contexts, in
# order (clicked face, click height in the block, player yaw: 0 south, 90 west; pitch: 60 down):
#   up 1.0 0.0 0.0; up 1.0 90.0 0.0; up 1.0 180.0 0.0; up 1.0 270.0 0.0; up 1.0 180.0 60.0
#   up 1.0 180.0 -60.0; down 0.0 180.0 0.0; north 0.25 0.0 0.0; north 0.75 0.0 0.0; east 0.25 90.0 0.0
#   east 0.75 90.0 0.0; south 0.25 180.0 0.0; south 0.75 180.0 0.0; west 0.25 270.0 0.0; west 0.75 270.0 0.0
# The top face is a grass block's under the target, the other faces a stone's. '"' repeats the state before.
# Java Edition 1.21.8: every block item.
